name: FreebiesUI
summary: Library of free and premium UI kits, app designs, web templates and mockups for Figma, Adobe Xd, Sketch and PSD.
description: A collection of downloadable design resources: app UI kits, web templates, mockups and typefaces in Figma, Adobe Xd, Sketch and Photoshop formats. Items are grouped into free and premium sections and collections, each with its own license note; commercial use is allowed while reselling the files is not.
contains: item types: app designs, UI kits, web templates, mockups, typefaces
free and premium sections (UI Free / UI Premium / UI Tools)
item files in Figma, Adobe Xd, Sketch and PSD
catalogued elements include dashboards (34), forms (15), 3D (9), cards, charts, maps, calendars
license: personal and commercial use, no attribution; no resale or redistribution of files
homepage feed currently carries unrelated spam/gambling posts
